spans.s: Attempted, sought, striven for; यद् विस्मर्तुमपीहितं शमवता
An undertaking, deed, act; प्रती- यते धातुरिवेहितं फलैः
; Śi.9.62. 219.25. -क्था N. of a metre, see Appendix.
Comp. पत्रः a sacrifice (having verses as its vehicle or leaves);
vessels or libations offered during the recitation of an उक्थ. -भृत् m. a sage who offers or divides Ukthas; उक्थभृतं सामभृतं बिभर्ति
.-वर्धन a. to be magnified or celebrated in praise, an epithet of Indra; त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः
. -वाहस् a. offering verses; or one to whom verses are offered; यं चित्रा उक्थवाहसो
.-शंसिन् a. praising, uttering the Ukthas. कृणोष्युक्थशंसिनः
. (m.) a kind of priest. -शस्, -शास्, -शस a. Ved. uttering a verse, praising. -शुष्म a. whose strength is praise.
loudly resonant with verses. (-क्था) -वी a. fond of or reciting verses.
